label: High loneliness with elevated depression and anxiety
summary: This profile is characterized by comparatively high loneliness alongside elevated depressive and anxiety symptoms across the measured indicators.
demographic_anchor: More likely to be female, hold a graduate degree or higher, and report more than 5 hours in the referenced time category.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively high loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Represents a training-split subgroup of 165 respondents
tone: Vulnerable, psychologically distressed, and socially disconnected

behavior_markers: Lower UCLA-8 loneliness score on average
Lower PHQ-9 depression score on average

label: Higher loneliness with lower depression and anxiety
